subject: Re: Acme Corp - POC Success Criteria & Trial Plan
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-18T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Acme POC — post-call recap & next steps

Hi Alex — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment before we kick off the trial: 

Summary of what we heard:
- Goal: Validate Redwood inference to reduce per-request latency for search re-ranking and to cut inference cost by ~40% vs current hosted endpoint.
- Primary success criteria: 95th percentile latency < 120ms for 512-token reranks; parity or better on NDCG@10 for the existing model within a 2% delta.
- Scope: ~10k daily requests across two regions for the POC; production integration is out of scope for this trial.

Proposed POC plan (high level):
1) Environment & access (owner: Acme infra / marissa): set up test keys + allowlist.
2) Baseline run (owner: Acme / priya): export a 48-hour sample of production rerank requests and labels.
3) Redwood test run (owner: dev): deploy model variant on our dedicated sandbox; run batch evaluation and latency tests.
4) Joint evaluation (owner: marissa + priya): compare metrics, review quality diff, and agree pass/fail.
5) Wrap & recommendation (owner: marissa): present outcomes and next steps for rollout or deeper evaluation.

Timeline suggestion: start next Monday (2026-03-23); baseline collection 2 business days; Redwood run 2 business days; joint review the following week (week of 2026-03-30).

Attachments: I attached a one-pager POC plan and a template for the requirements export (redwood-poc-plan-ACME-20260318.pdf, acme-requirements-20260318.xlsx).

Questions / asks for you to confirm:
- Confirm the success criteria above (latency/quality).
- Confirm owners for baseline export and infra allowlist.
- Any internal team members to loop in (security, procurement)?

Happy to revise timelines based on your calendar. Looking forward to getting started.

Best,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Thanks Marissa — this is great and matches what we discussed. A few notes: 

- Success criteria: agree with latency target (95p < 120ms) and quality tolerance (<= 2% NDCG@10). We also want to track tail error rate (5xxs) during the run.
- Owners: Priya will own the baseline export and will coordinate with infra to provision an allowlist. I'll loop in procurement separately for the contract.
- Security: we'll need the SOC2 summary and data handling notes before we provision any keys — can you send the SOC2 & an IP allowlist doc?

Timeline is fine — starting 2026-03-23 works for us. One more ask: Can your team provide a simple smoke test script (curl examples) and a sample dataset schema so our infra can validate ingestion?

Alex

Hi Alex / Marissa — following up with the technical plan and the artifacts Priya asked for. Summary below: 

What we'll provide by EOD Monday (2026-03-23):
- SOC2 summary (redwood-soc2-summary.pdf) and a short data handling note (we do not persist customer prompts beyond the session unless configured; logs are audit-only).
- Smoke-test curl examples and a tiny client script (node + bash) to exercise the rerank endpoint.
- A sample dataset schema describing fields we expect (id, query, candidate_ids, candidate_texts, ground_truth_rank).

Test harness & execution plan (sandbox):
- We'll stand up the model in a dedicated sandbox region matching your traffic profile.
- We'll run an initial baseline run using your exported 48-hour sample; produce latency percentiles and NDCG delta.
- We'll also run continuous low-volume traffic for 24 hours to surface any intermittent 5xxs or memory pressure.

Notes / questions for Acme infra:
1) For the allowlist, we need an IP CIDR or a static egress IP range to permit traffic from your collection job.
2) Sample export format: CSV/JSONL are fine; include a header describing the label column.

I'll drop the artifacts into the shared Drive folder and flag the SOC2 doc. Rafael and I will be available for a 30m run-through of the smoke tests on Wednesday (2026-03-25) if that helps.

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
